build_bert_model: build a multimodal BERT model that processes text and image inputs with shared attention
create_pretraining_model: create a BERT model with multi-modal pre-training heads for masked language and image prediction
run_vl_tasks: run vision-language tasks using BaseBertForVLTasks with pooled output classification and per-token logits
load_pretrained_bert: load a pretrained BERT model from HuggingFace archive or local checkpoint with weight initialization
create_simple_classifier: create a simple two-layer classifier with weight normalization, ReLU, and dropout for classification
